name: North Dakota
agency: North Dakota Game and Fish Department

rule.hpNote: motor over 10 hp (statute); Game and Fish page says at least 10 hp
rule.textEn: Only youths aged 12 to 15 need it: to run a boat or PWC with a motor over 10 hp alone they must pass the Boat North Dakota course, unless someone 18 or older is aboard.
rule.textEs: Solo lo necesitan los jóvenes de 12 a 15 años: para manejar solos una embarcación o moto acuática con motor de más de 10 hp deben aprobar el curso Boat North Dakota, salvo que vaya a bordo alguien de 18 años o más.

minAge.note: Under 12: no motorboat over 10 hp unless someone 18+ is aboard. Ages 12-15 alone need the course. No education rule from age 16.

card.nameEn: Boat North Dakota boater education card
card.feeNote: The home-study manual and mail-in exam are free from Game and Fish; the online versions are sold by private providers.

penalty: Class 2 noncriminal offense for an underage operator without the course or an adult aboard.

sources.publisher: North Dakota Game and Fish Department
sources.quote: This course is required for youth ages 12-15 who want to operate by themselves a boat or personal watercraft with at least a 10 horsepower motor .

sources.publisher: North Dakota Legislative Assembly, N.D. Century Code ch. 20.1-13
sources.quote: An individual  of twelve through fifteen years of age may  not  operate a motorboat  propelled by  over a ten horsepower motor unless the operator is accompanied by an individual eighteen years of age or older or the operator has taken and passed a  boating course approved by the department.

sources.publisher: North Dakota Legislative Assembly, N.D. Century Code ch. 20.1-13
sources.quote: An individual  under twelve years of age may  not  operate a motorboat propelled by  over a ten horsepower motor unless the operator is accompanied by  an individual  eighteen years of age or older.

sources.publisher: North Dakota Legislative Assembly, N.D. Century Code ch. 20.1-13
sources.quote: An individual who violates this subsection is guilty of a  class 2 noncriminal offense.

sources.publisher: North Dakota Game and Fish Department
sources.quote: There is no charge for the home-study course

sources.publisher: North Dakota Game and Fish Department
sources.quote: A Boat North Dakota course manual and a mail-in exam are available for free and may be ordered online .

sources.publisher: North Dakota Game and Fish Department
sources.quote: Upon completion of the online course and test students can print a temporary certification card.

sources.publisher: North Dakota Game and Fish Department
sources.quote: North Dakota law does not allow a youngster to operate a watercraft until age 12, therefore, a certification card will not be issued until the graduate is 12 years of age
